content.name: Fence
children:
roles:
  - name: alice
    login: true

grants:
  - role: alice
    privileges: [USAGE]
    object: { type: schema, name: app }
  - role: alice
    privileges: [SELECT]
    object: { type: table, schema: app, name: orders }

content.name: p
children: It works, but every new reader would duplicate those ACL entries. The next chapter gives the permission bundle a reusable name.
